name: AFM Question 13
description: This is a task related to Atomic Force Microscopy Imaging

examples.input: If you need to complete three scans (1x1, 5x5, and 15x15 \pu{um^2}) within 10 minutes total, and each has 512 lines at \pu{0.1 s} per line, how much time remains for tip approach and sample positioning?
